retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white scene featuring a group of figures in a dark cave or mine with rough, hand-painted dripping typography applied directly to the rock surface.
triggerTerms: dripping white paint text on rock

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men dressed as 19th-century miners stand at the mouth of a dark, jagged rock tunnel. The scene is captured in high-contrast monochrome, emphasizing the rough textures of the stone and the soot-covered clothing. Large, white, hand-painted letters with visible drips are positioned across the upper rock face.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures centered within the dark void of a cave entrance
Rough rock texture framing the subjects
High-contrast white text against dark stone
Leading lines from mine tracks in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five miners at medium scale, centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, arched opening of the mine shaft behind the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large text at the top left, down to the central figures, and along the tracks toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows within the cave and the heavy texture of the surrounding rock walls.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and rock depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays for clothing and rock highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the hand-painted text and direct lighting highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from crushed blacks to blown-out white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness suggesting a brush or finger application
Vertical drips extending from the bottom of characters
Irregular baseline following the rock contour
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'M' have elongated, uneven legs
Drips are most prominent on horizontal strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive hand-painted style used for all text elements to maintain environmental immersion.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, manual application of paint.
Mimics the dripping, uneven nature of the strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photograph of 19th-century miners standing at a dark cave entrance with mine tracks in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, hand-painted white capital letters with vertical paint drips across the upper rock face, following the natural curve of the cave ceiling.

verificationChecks: Do the letters have visible paint drips?
Is the rock texture highly detailed and gritty?
Are the figures dressed in period-appropriate industrial gear?

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical paint drips on all text
Ensure no color artifacts are present
Verify the text appears to be 'on' the rock, not floating
Confirm the historical accuracy of the miners' attire
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photography + Subterranean setting + Hand-painted dripping typography
